knobs.name: FLEET_AUTOPUSH_MODE
knobs.label: Autopush Mode
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only move it toward off.
knobs.note: what the autopush hooks may do;  full also needs FLEET_AUTOPUSH_IDLE_COMMIT

knobs.name: FLEET_AUTOPUSH_REPOS
knobs.label: Repositories Autopush May Touch
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only remove entries.
knobs.note: allowlist of owner/repo names the hooks may touch

knobs.name: FLEET_AUTOPUSH_IDLE_COMMIT
knobs.label: Idle Backstop May Commit
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only set it to false.

consequences.text: The idle backstop commits on its own when the mode is full.

knobs.note: true lets the idle backstop commit on its own (mode full only)

knobs.name: FLEET_AUTOPUSH_IDLE_HOURS
knobs.label: Idle Hours Before The Backstop
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only raise it.
knobs.note: hours a lane sits unchanged before the backstop sweep acts

knobs.name: FLEET_AUTOPUSH_PUBLIC_DRAFTS
knobs.label: Public Repositories For Draft PRs
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only remove entries.
knobs.note: public repos where a draft PR may open;  empty means none

knobs.name: FLEET_FACTS_SIGNING_KEY
knobs.label: Facts Signing Key
knobs.local_rule: A local file cannot change this.
knobs.note: HMAC key for the signed facts files;  never cached, a job without it publishes nothing

knobs.name: FLEET_FACTS_PUBLISH_FULL_COPY
knobs.label: Publish The Full Facts Copy
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only set it to false.

consequences.text: The full mac-facts.json is published, with lane paths, to everything that can read fleet-loops-data.

knobs.note: true also publishes the full mac-facts.json, which keeps lane paths and is readable by everything that can read fleet-loops-data;  false (the default) publishes only the path-free gb/ copy and the full list

knobs.name: FLEET_FACTS_PUBLISH_CAP_MINUTES
knobs.label: Publish Time Cap
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only lower it.
knobs.note: minutes a publish run may take before it ends itself and its child processes;  10 is the least that leaves room for the gatherers (5 minutes are reserved) and the writes

knobs.name: FLEET_FACTS_PUBLISH_MAX_LOAD1
knobs.label: Publish Load Limit
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only lower it.
knobs.note: a publish run is skipped when the one-minute load average is over this

knobs.name: FLEET_LOOPS_DATA_ALLOWED_APPS
knobs.label: Apps Allowed To Read Fleet-Loops-Data
knobs.local_rule: A local file cannot change this.
knobs.note: app slugs the owner accepts as able to read the private fleet-loops-data repository;  empty means the publisher refuses while any installed app can read it

knobs.name: NEEDS_OWNER_NOTIFY_PAUSED
knobs.label: Pause The Owner Notifier
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only set it to true.

consequences.text: The fallback notifier posts needs-owner notices again.
The fallback notifier stops posting until this is set back to false.

knobs.note: true pauses the fallback notifier;  an Infisical outage past the 48 hour copy limit reads false and unpauses it

knobs.name: NEEDS_OWNER_CAPS
knobs.label: Owner Notifier Post Caps
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only lower a number.
knobs.note: notifier post caps

knobs.name: OWNER_LINEAR_USER_ID
knobs.label: Owner's Linear User Id
knobs.local_rule: A local file cannot change this.
knobs.format: a Linear user id, which is a UUID
knobs.note: the owner's Linear user id;  empty means no Linear reply is accepted as the owner's

knobs.name: CLAIM_EXPIRY_MODE
knobs.label: Claim Expiry Mode
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only move it toward dry-run.
knobs.note: act also needs CLAIM_EXPIRY_LAUNCH_AT

knobs.name: CLAIM_EXPIRY_CAPS
knobs.label: Claim Expiry Caps
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only lower a number.
knobs.note: code ceilings are the same numbers;  Infisical can lower them

knobs.name: CLAIM_EXPIRY_LAUNCH_AT
knobs.label: Claim Clock Start
knobs.local_rule: A local file cannot change this.
knobs.format: an ISO 8601 time with its offset
knobs.note: ISO 8601 time the claim clock starts, set once;  empty means the clock has not started

knobs.name: ASK_CAPTURE_ENABLED
knobs.label: Ask Capture On
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only set it to false.
knobs.note: false turns the capture hooks and the drain off

knobs.name: ASK_CAPTURE_SHADOW
knobs.label: Ask Capture Shadow Mode
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only set it to true.

consequences.text: Captured asks may be filed with board instead of only listed for review.

knobs.note: true appends would-file rows for review and never calls board

knobs.name: ASK_CAPTURE_CAPS
knobs.label: Ask Capture Caps
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only lower a number.
knobs.note: extractor and filing caps

knobs.name: LANE_SWEEP_MODE
knobs.label: Lane Sweep Mode
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only move it toward report.

consequences.text: The sweep may merge and retire merged-PR lanes.
The sweep may merge, retire merged-PR lanes and make the Phase 3 deletions.

knobs.note: act arms merges and retires merged-PR lanes;  retire adds the Phase 3 deletions

knobs.name: LANE_SWEEP_CAPS
knobs.label: Lane Sweep Caps
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only lower a number.
knobs.note: sweep action caps

knobs.name: LANE_SWEEP_OPTIN_REPOS
knobs.label: Money-Path Repositories The Sweep May Touch
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only remove entries.
knobs.note: money-path repos the sweep may act on;  empty means none

knobs.name: OPERATOR_API_URL
knobs.label: Operator API Address
knobs.local_rule: A local file cannot change this.

consumers.name: simple-notes, the stdio MCP and the notes runner

knobs.format: an https origin with no path
knobs.note: the Operator API's https origin (no path):  where simple-notes, the stdio MCP and the Mac runner send Apple Notes requests off a Mac (docs/protocols/operator-notes.md);  empty means not configured;  the Worker has the same origin as its LISTENER_API_URL var

knobs.name: APPLE_NOTES_PIN_RETRY
knobs.label: Retry The Pin Shortcut
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only set it to false.
knobs.note: true lets apple-notes-coding.sh run the pin or unpin Shortcut a second time when the first run misses the note index;  false keeps the single attempt;  the APPLE_NOTES_PIN_RETRY environment variable is only a local narrowing override and can turn the retry off, never on

knobs.name: CONSULT_ENABLED
knobs.label: Consult On
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only set it to false.
knobs.note: false refuses every consult verb

knobs.name: FLEET_SHEET_INGEST_ENABLED
knobs.label: Recall Ingest After A Sheet Sync
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only set it to false.
knobs.note: false writes the registry mirror and skips the `recall ingest --source doc` that carries it;  the sheet itself is still written

knobs.name: FLEET_SHEET_INGEST_TIMEOUT_MS
knobs.label: Recall Ingest Time Limit
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only lower it.
knobs.note: milliseconds the Fleet RAG ingest may run before fleet-apps-sheet-sync.mjs gives up on it;  a full corpus walk took about 43 minutes, so the default is 90;  a local file may only lower it

knobs.name: COMPLIANCE_CERT_EXPIRY_DAYS
knobs.label: Certificate Expiry Warning
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only lower it.
knobs.note: days before an Apple signing certificate expires that the fleet-config compliance rule calls a finding;  the rule reads the value only once it is set in Infisical,  so the default is the value to set rather than one the rule may use

knobs.name: COMPLIANCE_SECRETS_FINDINGS_MAX
knobs.label: Secrets Findings Tolerated
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only lower it.
knobs.note: how many secrets-hygiene findings the fleet-config compliance rule tolerates;  the rule reads the value only once it is set in Infisical,  so the default is the value to set rather than one the rule may use

knobs.name: CF_USAGE_WATCHDOG_MODE
knobs.label: Cloudflare Watchdog Mode
knobs.local_rule: A local file can only move it toward observe.

consequences.text: The watchdog stops the Worker behind a breach, not only alerts.

knobs.note: observe only alerts;  enforce also stops the Worker behind a breach.  A STOP file in the watchdog's state directory forces observe

knobs.name: CF_USAGE_WATCHDOG_PROFILE
knobs.label: Cloudflare Watchdog Profile
knobs.local_rule: A local file cannot change this.
knobs.note: which threshold profile in config.json applies:  paid catches runaways, free is 80% of the Free caps
